dsh-tool-bandit-search 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。使用上下文赌博机算法（Thompson 采样）学习何时使用快速搜索、何时使用深度搜索的 `search` 工具。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ee28c29b1f79802df143.html
posts.en:
dsh-tool-bandit-search is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A `search` tool that learns to pick between fast and thorough search strategies using a contextual bandit (Thompson sampling), improving from real usage instead of a fixed heuristic.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ee28c29b1f79802df143.html
